title: Review of c34's nematic cargo (SIBWD): replicates on fresh seed 6 with the wall ablation: cargo in/out 13.7 vs 1.41, daughters 6.9 vs 1.28 five frames after birth (100% vs 0% >= 2), ring 99% of body-frames, 23 persistent splits to generation 4
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 6 (labkit, 128^2, T=1000) and with kappa=0 on the same seed, then c34's sd_individuals.py (channels 2 and 3) and inherit.py (results.txt). Rods nucleate from the noise by t~85-135 and multiply by binary fission to ~35 rods by t=1000 (rerun/sheet.png). Ring s: 380 body-frames, 99% pass both ratios (rim/core 2.68, rim/out 8.14). Cargo c (inside d<=-1 vs outside 2<=d<=4): median 13.68, 100% >= 2; kappa=0: 1.41, 4%. Inheritance: 34 daughters born by split, 5 frames after birth median 6.92 and 100% >= 2 (mid-life 4.17, 92%); kappa=0: 1.28 and 0%. Bodies are identical in both arms (37 splits, 23 persistent, generation 4, merge/split 0.24), since s and c do not act back.

observations.I: rerun/sheet.png t=135-1000: discrete rods at bounded size
observations.B: results.txt: s ring passes rim/core and rim/out >= 1.5 in 99% of 380 body-frames (2.68, 8.14); the source is rod pixels only
observations.W: results.txt: cargo in/out 13.68 (100% >= 2) vs 1.41 (4%) with kappa=0 on the same bodies
observations.D: rerun/lineage.png: 23 persistent splits, generation 4, merge/split 0.24; daughters keep the cargo (6.92, 100% >= 2 at +5 frames vs 1.28, 0% with kappa=0)

seeds_run.result: pass: ring, cargo containment and inheritance reproduce; kappa=0 loses the cargo; same bodies in both arms

verdicts.limitation: The wall works through a coupling written into the cargo flux (chemical potential ln c + kappa s) and the ring is a quasi-equilibrium coating pushed by a drift written against phi; both count because the rods make s and c, but neither acts back on the rods, so the wall does nothing for the rod. The cargo sits as a 1-2 px spine (ch3 rim/core 0.01), so the contrast is a core, not a lumen. I did not rerun the zeta=0 twin, the 1.5x grid or dt/2.
